novel.justification: This is a uniform away-from-feasibility-strata condition: every order excluded by the population moments has an observed residual off-diagonal bounded below by a preassigned tolerance. It is satisfied on compact families that avoid the finite union of wrong-order residual-equality varieties, including the explicit \(p=2,m=3\) strictness witness with its unequal \(1/5\) versus \(2/5\) disturbance correlation. The margin can be assessed by simultaneous lower confidence bounds for the finitely many residual scores.
